scope: All acquired standalone PDF and HTML text layers indexed; all acquired ZIP and derived Qorvo ZIP member names inventoried. No OCR, CAD geometry interpretation or RF performance validation is implied.
page_number_convention: pdf_page is physical PDF page starting at 1, not the printed page label.
low_text_note: Blank covers, figures, drawings and scanned pages can have little or no extractable text. The original PDF remains authoritative; these flags do not mean the original is corrupt.
